text: Even though crypto investments can be as volatile as or more volatile than traditional investments, digital currencies may still serve as a hedge against traditional investments because they are not tied to equity market movements.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: Although crypto investments can to be just as and more volatile than traditional investments, digital currencies might be used to hedge against traditional investments.

value: holds to the extent crypto returns are uncorrelated with traditional stock and equity markets
